name: Shorts Factory
description: From an idea to a published short in three steps: gather the sources (website brand and screenshots, documents, cloud folders, videos, sounds), produce a scroll-stopping vertical video and its marketing covers with Remotion in the brand's own look, then write one caption per network and publish or schedule on YouTube Shorts, TikTok, Instagram Reels, X and Bluesky through Postiz — or get a ready-to-upload kit. Built to show off a SaaS or illustrate an idea in 15 to 35 seconds; nothing invented, nothing published without approval.
